title_en: JANUS Guardian Mesh v1.1 — ROOSTERS Inversion, Armor of God, and Civic Trust Bridge
title_uk: JANUS Guardian Mesh v1.1 — інверсія ROOSTERS, Доспіхи Бога та громадянський міст довіри
title_ru: JANUS Guardian Mesh v1.1 — инверсия «Петушков», Доспехи Бога и гражданский мост доверия

purpose.en: Extend Guardian Mesh from internal N-Face orchestration into a transparent public-service architecture that helps people access, verify, contextualize, and leave high-pressure information loops without replacing one information cage with another.
purpose.uk: Розширити Guardian Mesh від внутрішньої оркестрації N Лиць до прозорої архітектури публічного сервісу, що допомагає людині отримати доступ до інформації, перевірити її, відновити контекст і вийти з інформаційної петлі без заміни однієї клітки іншою.
purpose.ru: Расширить Guardian Mesh от внутренней оркестрации N Лиц до прозрачного публичного сервиса: доступ → проверка → контекст → выход из петли. Не менять один пузырь на наш фирменный пузырь с петухом на гербе.

strategic_thesis.en: ROOSTERS protected access to information. Armor protects the human receiving information. Guardian Mesh connects the two while preserving user autonomy.
strategic_thesis.uk: ROOSTERS захищав доступ до інформації. Доспіхи Бога захищають людину, яка цю інформацію отримує. Guardian Mesh поєднує обидва шари, зберігаючи автономію користувача.
strategic_thesis.ru_postirony: Старые Петушки выясняли, как проходит пакет. Новый Янус ещё спрашивает, что пакет сделал с человеком. Петух эволюционировал, но право голосовать за истину ему так и не выдали.

evolution: ROOSTERS_V1: map transport filtering and resilience.
ROOSTERS_V2: analyze protection and systemic constraints.
ROOSTERS_V2_3: move from reactive countermeasures toward cognitive orchestration.
GUARDIAN_MESH_V1_1: invert the objective from defeating a filter to preserving informed human autonomy across transport, platform, recommendation, advertising, propaganda, scam, and stress layers.

legacy_offensive_quarantine.rule: Historical ROOSTERS offensive/circumvention material is provenance, not an executable inheritance for Guardian Mesh.
not_inherited: adversarial evasion procedures intended to defeat third-party controls
deception intended to create paranoia inside an opposing organization
inherited_only: architecture -> vulnerability -> human factor -> paradox -> future threat -> protection reasoning pattern
transport/access layer as one layer rather than the whole mission

guardian_translation.BREAK_THE_CAGE: Expose recommendation, advertising, subscription, source-lineage, and repetition mechanisms without claiming hostile intent by default.
guardian_translation.PROTECT_THE_CHILD: Increase safety with vulnerability while avoiding surveillance, coercion, or permanent profiling.
guardian_translation.ASK_THE_QUESTION: Separate claim, source, evidence, uncertainty, chronology, and action.
guardian_translation.LEAVE_THE_DOOR_OPEN: Never replace one closed worldview with a JANUS-controlled worldview; preserve alternatives, opt-out, and exit.

armor_of_god_binding.hard_boundary: FREEDOM + REALITY_CONTACT + SAFETY + RESPONSIBILITY MUST NOT DECREASE.

civic_trust_bridge.deployment_principle: A voluntary, transparent, user-invoked verification and navigation service, not a covert influence network.
interfaces: dedicated non-emergency short code / SMS entry
official mobile application or deep-link entry
public API gateway for authorized public-service clients
accessibility interfaces for people with hearing, speech, vision, cognitive, or language barriers

do_not_overload.reason: 112 is an emergency safety service. Verification and media-literacy traffic should use a separate non-emergency entry even if the trust and accessibility lessons of 112 are reused.

existing_ukrainian_infrastructure_candid.role: precedent for a nationally recognizable trusted safety entry and accessibility-oriented digital contact
candidate downstream path for phishing, malicious resources, scam imitation, and harmful-resource reporting

existing_ukrainian_infrastructure_candid.role: candidate source corpus for published anti-fake and information-security material
candidate source corpus for documented disinformation cases and threat analysis
time-sensitive primary records for local alerts, utilities, evacuation, public-service changes, and official decisions

civic_trust_bridge.source_authority_rule: OFFICIAL_SOURCE is authoritative for what that institution officially decided, published, ordered, or currently reports within its mandate; OFFICIAL_SOURCE != AUTOMATIC_OBJECTIVE_TRUTH_FOR_ALL_CONTESTED_CLAIMS.

face_mesh_for_civic_service.routing_rule: Higher risk increases independent review, counterexample search, and human escalation; it must not increase any Face's authority weight.
face_mesh_for_civic_service.settlement_rule: External actions remain typed capability effects with authorization, bounded scope, and receipts.

ru.purpose: Accessibility for Russian-speaking users and optional tension-reducing post-irony, not identity targeting and not covert persuasion.

postirony_mode.requires: explicit user preference or clearly casual non-emergency context
postirony_mode.label: POSTIRONY / ЮМОР
goals: make manipulative bait patterns easier to notice
forbidden_contexts: children unless an age-appropriate safety design explicitly permits humor
legal or medical high-stakes instructions where humor could obscure action
targeted persuasion based on inferred political or psychological vulnerability
examples_ru: «СРОЧНО!!! Источник: знакомый знакомого видел скриншот». Янус просит источник чуть менее мифологический.

Если баннер орёт громче сирены, он пока не становится официальным документом.

language_and_style_policy.translation_integrity: LANGUAGE_CHANGE MUST NOT CHANGE EVIDENCE_STATUS, UNCERTAINTY, OR AVAILABLE_OPTIONS.

state_power_firewall.central_rule: A STATE-SUPPORTED TRUST SERVICE MUST MAKE VERIFICATION EASIER, NOT MAKE DISAGREEMENT HARDER.
forbidden: covert state personas posing as independent citizens
political microtargeting optimized to change beliefs
automatic criminal or administrative sanctions from model output
secret blacklists generated solely by AI classification
suppression of lawful disagreement merely because it contradicts an official position
continuous monitoring as a condition for receiving protection
using a crisis or state of emergency as a permanent waiver of these constraints
required: clear service identity and operator disclosure
user initiation for personalized dialogue except narrowly defined public emergency broadcast channels governed separately
distinction between official position and independently corroborated evidence
opt-out and context deletion where legally and operationally possible
civil-society and research access to aggregate performance evidence

doomsday_machine_firewall.title_ru_postirony: Чтобы Петушки однажды не проснулись Скайнетом
doomsday_machine_firewall.goal: Prevent Guardian Mesh capabilities from composing into an autonomous mass-influence or uncontrolled external-action system.
control_plane: fresh human reauthorization for high-impact external effects
global pause / kill switch controlled outside the Face mesh
safe degraded mode that preserves verification but disables outbound publication
separation of evidence engine from empathy/style engine
doomsday_machine_firewall.failure_definition: If JANUS can secretly select an audience, fabricate social proof, publish at scale, adapt persuasion to psychological vulnerability, erase its own receipts, or make itself indispensable, the deployment fails Armor admission even if engagement or influence metrics improve.
doomsday_machine_firewall.canonical_joke_with_serious_semantics: «Машина Судного дня» остаётся шуткой только пока у неё нет кнопки «опубликовать всем, кого мы уже психологически просчитали».

loop_closure: show safe next action if one exists
tell the user when no new verified information exists
offer to stop rather than manufacture another recommendation
if user opted into recovery mode, offer neutral content without embedding political messaging
engagement_and_recovery.tsw_binding: Neutral bridge content may reduce high-arousal looping, but it must not become a covert channel for state messaging or an engagement farm.

priority_cohorts: professionals exposed to disturbing material for work
vulnerability_and_account_separation.privacy_rule: Do not infer or store sensitive vulnerability labels merely because a user consumed related content; prefer explicit user-selected modes and minimal contextual state.

public_service_minimum_viable_flow.example: User forwards a frightening post, ad-shaped bait, scam link, screenshot, or rumor.
steps: JANUS identifies itself and the service operator.
JANUS extracts discrete claims without judging the user.
Faces build source, chronology, and independence graphs.
Scam/phishing Face checks domain and impersonation indicators when relevant.
Relevant official primary source is queried when the claim is about that institution's own decision or service.
Independent corroboration is sought where the claim is broader than an institution's own statement.
Response is rendered in user-selected language/style with identical evidence semantics.
If high-stakes or ambiguous, human-review path is offered or required.
If the loop is closed, JANUS explicitly permits disengagement.

research_and_governance_gates: Build a frozen multilingual benchmark where UA/EN/RU renderings must preserve the same verdict, evidence roots, uncertainty, and options.
Test post-irony on comprehension and anxiety reduction without measuring political conversion as a success metric.
Create adversarial cases where official sources are incomplete, outdated, conflicting, or wrong; system must permit UNVERIFIED and CONTRADICTORY_EVIDENCE.
Stress-test attempts to convert many Faces into synthetic authority.
Test covert-persuasion prompts; Guardian Mesh must reject them while still providing transparent verification assistance.
Benchmark public-service latency separately from emergency-service latency; verification traffic must not compete with emergency response.
Test correction propagation: corrected source must update derived explanations while preserving historical lineage.
Publish aggregate false-positive, false-negative, unresolved, escalation, correction, and appeal metrics.
Independent holdout and external audit required before claiming real-world effectiveness.

allowed: Guardian Mesh can be specified as a transparent civic verification and epistemic-navigation architecture over existing Genesis orchestration and capability boundaries.
ROOSTERS provides a transport/resilience lineage that can be inverted toward human autonomy without inheriting historical offensive procedures.
Existing Ukrainian public services provide real precedents and source corpora relevant to a future trust bridge.
Post-irony can be represented as an optional presentation mode with strict evidence invariance and safety exclusions.
Genesis capability separation, authority epochs, reauthorization, and receipts are useful safety primitives for preventing uncontrolled external effects.
forbidden: This artifact proves a Ukrainian government deployment exists.
JANUS is authorized to act on behalf of the Ukrainian state.
JANUS may covertly influence Russian or any other population.
Russian-language post-irony is evidence of effectiveness against a nationality or political group.
A model verdict is sufficient for censorship, punishment, or legal action.
Guardian Mesh has proven population-scale safety or effectiveness.
Genesis has proven unlimited autonomous public-platform control.
